from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, io, json, os, re, subprocess, sys, time, zipfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
mode = sys.argv[1]
tag = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "final"
baseline = 'b345d95cc9adf585e56071840201fb50df5858e4'
archive_root = root / 'product/.runtime/subtitle-clock-baseline-20261016'
if mode == 'before':
    archive = subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'core.autocrlf=false', 'archive', '--format=zip', baseline, 'product/src', 'docs/specs/agent-project.schema.json'], cwd=root, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
    archive_root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive)) as package:
        for item in package.infolist():
            if item.is_dir():
                continue
            relative = Path(item.filename)
            assert not relative.is_absolute() and '..' not in relative.parts and (item.filename.startswith('product/src/') or item.filename == 'docs/specs/agent-project.schema.json')
            target = archive_root / relative
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            raw = package.read(item)
            if target.exists():
                assert target.read_bytes() == raw, str(target)
            else:
                target.write_bytes(raw)

paths = sorted([*(root / 'product/src').rglob('*.py'), *(root / 'product/tests').rglob('*.py')])
def hashes():
    return {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
before = hashes()
schema_before = 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256((root / 'docs/specs/agent-project.schema.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
began = time.monotonic()
env = os.environ.copy()
task_temp = root / 'product/.runtime/subtitle-clock-native-temp'
task_temp.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
env['TEMP'] = str(task_temp)
env['TMP'] = str(task_temp)
env['PYTHONPATH'] = str(archive_root / 'product/src' if mode == 'before' else root / 'product/src')
command = [sys.executable, '-B', '-X', 'utf8', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'product/tests']
if mode != 'full':
    command += ['-p', 'test_subtitle_clock.py']
command += ['-v']
log = root / f'product/.runtime/subtitle-clock-{tag}-{mode}-20261016.log'
assert not log.exists(), 'Preserve earlier captured runs: choose a fresh tag'
with log.open('xb') as handle:
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=env, stdout=handle, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
after = hashes()
schema_after = 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256((root / 'docs/specs/agent-project.schema.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
raw = log.read_bytes()
match = re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests in ([0-9.]+)s', raw.decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
record = {'started_at_utc': started, 'finished_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'exit_code': result.returncode, 'status': 'passed' if result.returncode == 0 and before == after and schema_before == schema_after and match else 'failed-or-source-changed',
          'test_count': int(match[1]) if match else None, 'suite_seconds': float(match[2]) if match else None,
          'wall_seconds': time.monotonic() - began, 'source_sha256_before': before, 'source_sha256_after': after,
          'source_file_count': len(paths), 'schema_sha256_before': schema_before, 'schema_sha256_after': schema_after, 'baseline_ref': baseline if mode == 'before' else None,
          'source_path': env['PYTHONPATH'], 'command': command, 'log_sha256': 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
(root / f'product/.runtime/subtitle-clock-{tag}-{mode}-20261016.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({k: record[k] for k in ['status', 'test_count', 'suite_seconds', 'source_file_count', 'exit_code']}), flush=True)
sys.exit(result.returncode or int(before != after or schema_before != schema_after))

"""Audit all 14 local video-cut skills after the nested source-clock update."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from urllib.parse import unquote

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
skill_home = Path('C:/Users/carzy/.codex/skills')
validator = skill_home / '.system/skill-creator/scripts/quick_validate.py'
results = []; broken = []
folders = sorted((root / 'skills').glob('video-cut-*'))
assert len(folders) == 14
for folder in folders:
    completed = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-X', 'utf8', str(validator), str(folder)], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', timeout=30)
    source = folder / 'SKILL.md'; text = source.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    link_count = 0
    for match in re.finditer(r'!?\[[^\]\n]*\]\(([^)\n]+)\)', text):
        target = match[1]
        if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:', target) or target.startswith('#'):
            continue
        target = unquote(target.split('#', 1)[0]); link_count += 1
        if not (source.parent / target).exists(): broken.append({'skill': folder.name, 'target': target})
    installed = skill_home / folder.name
    item = {'skill': folder.name, 'validator_exit_code': completed.returncode, 'validator_stdout': completed.stdout.strip(), 'validator_stderr': completed.stderr.strip(),
            'sha256': 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'local_links_checked': link_count,
            'installed_directory_resolves_to_repo': installed.resolve() == folder.resolve()}
    results.append(item)
record = {'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'validator': str(validator), 'skill_count': len(results),
          'results': results, 'broken_links': broken, 'scope': 'official frontmatter/scaffold validator, local Markdown file targets and installed directory junction resolution; no semantic quality guarantee'}
target = root / 'docs/validation/evidence/skills-audit-subtitle-clock-20261016.json'
target.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
assert not broken and all(r['validator_exit_code'] == 0 and r['installed_directory_resolves_to_repo'] for r in results)
print(json.dumps({'skill_count': len(results), 'broken_links': broken, 'all_validators_and_junctions_passed': True}))

"""Audit final local Markdown paths, metadata and immutable document digests."""
from __future__ import annotations
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib,json,re
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];target=root/'docs/validation/evidence/docs-audit-subtitle-clock-20261016.json'
if not target.exists():target.write_text('{}\n',encoding='utf-8')
files=[root/'README.md',root/'AGENTS.md',*sorted(root.joinpath('docs').rglob('*.md'))]
links=local=external=0;broken=[];empty=[];invalid=[];digests={}
for p in files:
 s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig');rel=p.relative_to(root).as_posix();digests[rel]='sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 if not s.strip():empty.append(rel)
 status=re.search(r'^\|\s*状态\s*\|\s*([^|]+)\|',s,re.M)
 if status and status[1].strip() not in {'草案','评审中','有效','已替代','归档'}:invalid.append({'file':rel,'state':status[1].strip()})
 for m in re.finditer(r'!?\[[^\]\n]*\]\(([^)\n]+)\)',s):
  links+=1;t=m[1].strip()
  if t.startswith('<') and '>' in t:t=t[1:t.index('>')]
  else:t=re.split(r"\s+[\"']",t,maxsplit=1)[0]
  if t.startswith('#'):continue
  if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:',t) and not re.match(r'^[A-Za-z]:[/\\]',t):external+=1;continue
  t=unquote(t.split('#',1)[0].split('?',1)[0])
  if not t:continue
  local+=1;resolved=Path(t);resolved=resolved if resolved.is_absolute() else p.parent/resolved
  if not resolved.exists():broken.append({'file':rel,'target':t})
result={'checked_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'README.md, AGENTS.md and docs/**/*.md; local Markdown targets and first metadata state; no external fetch or anchor validation',
 'markdown_files':len(files),'links':links,'local_file_links':local,'external_links_not_fetched':external,'broken_links':broken,'empty_documents':empty,'invalid_metadata_states':invalid,'document_sha256':digests, 'subtitle_clock': {'independent_delivery_evidence_sha256':'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256((root/'docs/validation/evidence/subtitle-clock-20261016.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'verification_sha256':'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256((root/'docs/assets/subtitle-clock-20261016/evidence.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'public_original_and_output_videos':21}}
target.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ['markdown_files','links','local_file_links','external_links_not_fetched','broken_links','empty_documents','invalid_metadata_states']},ensure_ascii=False));assert not (broken or empty or invalid)
